meta.name: cs-customer-research
meta.description: Pesquisa multi-fonte sobre pergunta ou tópico de cliente com atribuição de fontes. Use quando um cliente pergunta algo que precisa ser verificado, investigando se um bug foi reportado antes, verificando o que foi dito anteriormente a uma conta específica, ou coletando contexto antes de redigir uma resposta. / Multi-source research on a customer question or topic with source attribution. Use when a customer asks something you need to look up, investigating whether a bug has been reported before, checking what was previously told to a specific account, or gathering background before drafting a response.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 多源调研客户问题并标注来源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查证客户问题、历史记录或背景信息。
copy.tagline_en: Research customer questions from multiple sources with attribution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly verify customer questions, history, or context.

howto.what: 安装后，当用户提出研究请求时，Claude会从多个来源（内部文档、CRM、团队聊天、网络等）系统搜索，整理成带置信度和来源的结构化简报。
howto.when: 当客户提出需要查证的问题，或需要调查是否已有bug报告、核对之前对特定账户的回复、收集写回复所需的背景时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个bug之前有没有人报过。
say.note: Claude会搜索工单、聊天记录等，返回是否已有报告。

say.text: 查查Acme Corp上次问SSO时我们怎么回的。
say.note: Claude会在CRM和邮件中查找历史对话。

say.text: 研究一下webhook重试的最佳实践。
say.note: Claude会从内部文档和网络搜索，汇总最佳实践。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude performs multi-source research (internal docs, CRM, chats, web, etc.) and synthesizes findings into a structured briefing with confidence levels and source attribution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a customer asks something that needs verification, investigating if a bug was reported before, checking what was previously told to an account, or gathering background before drafting a response.

say_en.text: Check if this bug has been reported before.
say_en.note: Claude searches tickets, chat logs, etc., returns findings.

say_en.text: Look up what we told Acme Corp about SSO last time.
say_en.note: Claude searches CRM and email for previous conversations.

say_en.text: Research best practices for webhook retry logic.
say_en.note: Claude searches internal docs and web, compiles best practices.
